Central Arkansas Defeats UT Martin in College Football Game

Central Arkansas secured a 36-24 victory over UT Martin in a college football game. Donovyn Omolo was instrumental in the win, throwing three touchdown passes for Central Arkansas. The game saw Central Arkansas score 36 points to UT Martin's 24.
